name: maga
description: Make Apps Great Again with a proactive Codex lead, durable project memory, and native subagent runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Make Apps Great Again with a proactive Codex lead.
interface.longDescription: Make Apps Great Again. Start with one pinned product lead, use bounded native read-only subagents for short questions, and coordinate clearly named workers for durable approved Ticket outcomes. MAGA passes repository-relative context, recovers task state, persists accepted design records, and can use bounded thread Goals when the host supports them. It also registers nineteen focused Skills, applies Bar Tester, Humanization, Git-safe delivery, internal product methods, and Ponytail lifecycle behavior.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this product idea into a working first version.
Configure the model and reasoning depth for each MAGA responsibility.
Continue this project from its current state.
